<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 182.0732, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈181.0659 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely is C₉H₁₁NO₃ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 181.0739 Da, within typical MS error). Therefore, the molecular formula of the compound is C9H11NO3.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H11NO3</final_answer>
